manifest.description: Build, deploy, and operate applications on AWS. Skills to author infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation), use core services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, ECS/Fargate, ECR, IAM, Amazon Bedrock with Knowledge Bases and Guardrails, AWS Blocks), select and operate databases across relational, key-value, document, wide-column, graph, time-series, and in-memory engines, and complete common tasks across observability, messaging and streaming, AWS SDKs, cost optimization, and Well-Architected Framework reviews across all six pillars.
manifest.name: aws-core
